findings.summary: ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N16R8 (octal PSRAM) is rated for -40..65 C ambient only
findings.description: R8/R16V modules have a lower ambient rating than other WROOM-1 variants. Inside a closed cartridge shell in a warm console, with U22 dissipating up to ~0.3 W about 15 mm away, the module's ambient can approach this limit.
findings.recommendation: Keep in mind for the housing (vent slots near U21/U22 or avoid sealing it airtight); do not enable PSRAM ECC, which lowers the limit further.

findings.summary: Q1 pulls the console's /RESET (cart pin 26) low by default; safe only if the console drives that line open-drain or through a resistor
findings.description: R16 pulls RST_GATE to +3V3, so Q1 conducts whenever +3V3 is up and GPIO17 is not driven low, including during ESP boot. If the SNES drives cart /RESET push-pull, Q1 fights that driver with no series resistance.
findings.recommendation: Before the production run, confirm the console-side /RESET driver type on a real console (for example, pull pin 26 low through 100 ohm and measure the current). If it is push-pull, add a series resistor in Q1's drain or reset via the CIC instead.

computation.result: RST_GATE = {Q1.G, R1, R16}; R16.1 on +3V3; SNES_RESET_N = {P1./RESET, Q1.D, U14 input}

findings.summary: Zone copper fills the gold-finger tab on all four layers: GND slivers between fingers and a continuous copper bar at the bevelled tip
findings.description: F.Cu/B.Cu GND pour sits in 22 of 23 finger gaps and along the tip strip below the fingers; In1 (GND) and In2 (+5V) planes fill the whole tab up to 0.3 mm from the bevelled edge. A 45 deg bevel on 1.2 mm board grinds into the tip strip and approaches the inner planes; console slot contacts slide over this area on every insertion.
findings.recommendation: Add a rule area (no copper pour; tracks and pads allowed) on F.Cu, In1.Cu, In2.Cu and B.Cu covering the tab (x 120..180, y >= ~154), refill zones, re-run DRC.

computation.description: Clip stored zone fill polygons to the tab rectangle and sample finger gaps (y=160) and the tip strip (y=164.0)

findings.summary: U22 AP2112K-3.3 junction temperature is fine for realistic ESP32-S3 loads, marginal only for sustained 500 mA
findings.description: VIN is about 4.6 V after the 1N5819WS OR-ing diode. With the datasheet theta_JA of 184 C/W (no heatsink), 250 mA gives Tj ~100 C at 40 C ambient; a sustained 500 mA would exceed 150 C. WiFi TX peaks are bursts, and the GND pour lowers the real theta_JA.
findings.recommendation: No change needed for normal use. Cap WiFi TX power in firmware if long transfers run inside a closed shell.

computation.description: Tj = Ta + (VIN - 3.3 V) * I * 184 C/W, VIN = 5.0 V - 0.40 V
computation.result: Ta 40 C: 150 mA -> 75.9 C, 250 mA -> 99.8 C, 500 mA sustained -> 159.6 C (over 150 C)
